307	pub(crate) fn checkpoint_remote_url(repo_dir: &str) -> Option<String> {
308	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
309	    struct EntireSettings {
310	        strategy_options: Option<StrategyOptions>,
311	    }
312	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
313	    struct StrategyOptions {
314	        checkpoint_remote: Option<CheckpointRemote>,
315	    }
316	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
317	    struct CheckpointRemote {
318	        repo: String,
319	    }
320	
321	    let settings_path = std::path::Path::new(repo_dir).join(".entire").join("settings.json");
322	    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(settings_path).ok()?;
323	    let settings: EntireSettings = serde_json::from_str(&raw).ok()?;
324	    let cp_repo = settings.strategy_options?.checkpoint_remote?.repo;
325	
326	    let use_ssh = Command::new("git")
327	        .args(["remote", "get-url", "origin"])
328	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
329	        .output()
330	        .ok()
331	        .and_then(|o| String::from_utf8(o.stdout).ok())
332	        .map(|u| u.trim_start().starts_with("git@") || u.trim_start().starts_with("ssh://"))
333	        .unwrap_or(true);
334	
335	    let url = if use_ssh {
336	        format!("git@github.com:{}.git", cp_repo)
337	    } else {
338	        format!("https://github.com/{}.git", cp_repo)
339	    };
340	
341	    Some(url)
342	}

344	#[allow(clippy::type_complexity)]
345	pub(crate) fn parse_session(
346	    meta_bytes: &[u8],
347	    jsonl_bytes: &[u8],
348	    user: &str,
349	) -> Result<(String, String, String, String, String, String)> {
350	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
351	    struct SessionMetadata {
352	        session_id: String,
353	        agent: Option<String>,
354	        created_at: Option<String>,
355	        summary: Option<Summary>,
356	    }
357	    #[derive(Deserialize)]
358	    struct Summary {
359	        intent: Option<String>,
360	    }
361	
362	    let meta: SessionMetadata = serde_json::from_slice(meta_bytes)
363	        .context("failed to parse metadata.json")?;
364	
365	    let created_at: DateTime<Utc> = meta
366	        .created_at
367	        .as_deref()
368	        .and_then(|s| DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(s).ok())
369	        .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))
370	        .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
371	
372	    let session_name = meta
373	        .summary
374	        .and_then(|s| s.intent)
375	        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
376	        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("session:{}", &meta.session_id[..8]));
377	
378	    let agent_name = meta.agent.unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string());
379	
380	    let mut latest: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;
381	    let mut cwd = String::new();
382	    let mut last_prompt: Option<String> = None;
383	    let mut custom_title: Option<String> = None;
384	
385	    for line in jsonl_bytes.split(|&b| b == b'\n') {
386	        if line.is_empty() { continue; }
387	        let v: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(line) {
388	            Ok(v) => v,
389	            Err(_) => continue,
390	        };
391	
392	        if let Some(ts) = v.get("timestamp").and_then(Value::as_str) {
393	            if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(ts) {
394	                let dt: DateTime<Utc> = dt.with_timezone(&Utc);
395	                if latest.map_or(true, |l| dt > l) { latest = Some(dt); }
396	            }
397	        }
398	
399	        if cwd.is_empty() {
400	            if let Some(c) = v.get("cwd").and_then(Value::as_str) { cwd = c.to_string(); }
401	        }
402	
403	        match v.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
404	            Some("custom-title") => {
405	                if let Some(t) = v.get("customTitle").and_then(Value::as_str) {
406	                    if !t.trim().is_empty() { custom_title = Some(t.trim().to_string()); }
407	                }
408	            }
409	            Some("user") => {
410	                if let Some(Value::String(text)) = v.get("message").and_then(|m| m.get("content")) {
411	                    let text = text.trim().to_string();
412	                    if !text.is_empty() { last_prompt = Some(text); }
413	                }
414	            }
415	            _ => {}
416	        }
417	    }
418	
419	    let updated_at = latest.unwrap_or(created_at);
420	    // Priority: explicit rename > last user prompt > metadata summary
421	    let session_name = custom_title.or(last_prompt).unwrap_or(session_name);
422	
423	    Ok((
424	        meta.session_id,
425	        agent_name,
426	        created_at.to_rfc3339(),
427	        updated_at.to_rfc3339(),
428	        cwd,
429	        session_name,
430	    ))
431	}
432	
433	pub(crate) fn upsert_session(
434	    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
435	    session_id: &str,
436	    agent_name: &str,
437	    user: &str,
438	    created_at: &str,
439	    updated_at: &str,
440	    cwd: &str,
441	    session_name: &str,
442	) -> Result<()> {
443	    // agent_name is preserved on update if the existing row already has one —
444	    // shadow branches don't carry a reliable agent identifier, so we don't want
445	    // a shadow upsert to clobber an agent_name that the checkpoint scan or the
446	    // session-start hook already set authoritatively.
447	    conn.execute(
448	        "INSERT INTO sessions (session_id, agent_name, user, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name)
449	         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7)
450	         ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
451	           agent_name   = CASE WHEN COALESCE(sessions.agent_name, '') = ''
452	                               THEN excluded.agent_name
453	                               ELSE sessions.agent_name END,
454	           updated_at   = MAX(sessions.updated_at, excluded.updated_at),
455	           cwd          = CASE WHEN excluded.cwd != '' THEN excluded.cwd ELSE sessions.cwd END,
456	           session_name = excluded.session_name",
457	        rusqlite::params![session_id, agent_name, user, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name],
458	    )?;
459	    Ok(())
460	}

98	fn strip_system_content(text: &str) -> String {
99	    let mut s = text.to_string();
100	    let re_open = Regex::new(r"<([a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-:][a-z0-9_]+)+)[\s>]").unwrap();
101	    loop {
102	        let m = match re_open.find(&s) {
103	            Some(m) => m,
104	            None => break,
105	        };
106	        let start = m.start();
107	        let caps = re_open.captures(&s[start..]).unwrap();
108	        let tag_name = caps.get(1).unwrap().as_str().to_string();
109	        let close_tag = format!("</{tag_name}>");
110	        let after_open = match s[start..].find('>') {
111	            Some(i) => start + i + 1,
112	            None => break,
113	        };
114	        let end = match s[after_open..].find(&close_tag) {
115	            Some(i) => after_open + i + close_tag.len(),
116	            None => {
117	                let line_end = s[start..].find('\n').map(|i| start + i + 1).unwrap_or(s.len());
118	                s.replace_range(start..line_end, "");
119	                continue;
120	            }
121	        };
122	        s.replace_range(start..end, "");
123	    }
124	    let re = Regex::new(r"\[Request interrupted by user[^\]]*\]").unwrap();
125	    s = re.replace_all(&s, "").to_string();
126	    if let Some(idx) = s.find("This session is being continued from a previous conversation") {
127	        s.truncate(idx);
128	    }
129	    s
130	}
131	
132	fn strip_code(text: &str) -> String {
133	    let re = Regex::new(r"```[\s\S]*?```").unwrap();
134	    let s = re.replace_all(text, " ").to_string();
135	    let re = Regex::new(r"```[\s\S]*$").unwrap();
136	    let s = re.replace_all(&s, " ").to_string();
137	    let re = Regex::new(r"`[^`]*`").unwrap();
138	    re.replace_all(&s, " ").to_string()
139	}
140	
141	fn strip_tables(text: &str) -> String {
142	    text.lines()
143	        .filter(|line| {
144	            let t = line.trim();
145	            !(t.starts_with('|') && t.ends_with('|'))
146	        })
147	        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
148	        .join("\n")
149	}
150	
151	fn compact(text: &str) -> String {
152	    let re = Regex::new(r"\s{2,}").unwrap();
153	    re.replace_all(text, " ").trim().to_string()
154	}
155	
156	fn parse_session_content(content: &str) -> (SessionInfo, Vec<Chunk>) {
157	    let mut chunks = Vec::new();
158	    let mut info = SessionInfo { custom_title: None, cwd: None };
159	    let mut offset: u64 = 0;
160	
161	    for line in content.lines() {
162	        let line_offset = offset;
163	        offset += line.len() as u64 + 1;
164	
165	        if line.trim().is_empty() {
166	            continue;
167	        }
168	
169	        let entry: SessionEntry = match serde_json::from_str(line) {
170	            Ok(e) => e,
171	            Err(_) => continue,
172	        };
173	
174	        if entry.entry_type == "custom-title" {
175	            if let Some(ref title) = entry.custom_title {
176	                info.custom_title = Some(title.clone());
177	            }
178	            continue;
179	        }
180	
181	        if info.cwd.is_none() {
182	            if let Some(ref cwd) = entry.cwd {
183	                info.cwd = Some(cwd.clone());
184	            }
185	        }
186	
187	        if entry.entry_type != "user" && entry.entry_type != "assistant" {
188	            continue;
189	        }
190	
191	        let msg = match &entry.message {
192	            Some(m) => m,
193	            None => continue,
194	        };
195	
196	        let role = match &msg.role {
197	            Some(r) if r == "user" || r == "assistant" => r.clone(),
198	            _ => continue,
199	        };
200	
201	        let content_field = match &msg.content {
202	            Some(c) => c,
203	            None => continue,
204	        };
205	
206	        let raw_text = match extract_text(content_field) {
207	            Some(t) => t,
208	            None => continue,
209	        };
210	
211	        let text = sanitize(&raw_text);
212	        if text.is_empty() {
213	            continue;
214	        }
215	
216	        if !(MIN_CHUNK_CODEPOINTS..=MAX_CHUNK_CODEPOINTS).contains(&codepoint_len(&text)) {
217	            continue;
218	        }
219	
220	        let timestamp = match &entry.timestamp {
221	            Some(ts) if !ts.is_empty() => ts.clone(),
222	            _ => continue,
223	        };
224	
225	        let ts_ms = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&timestamp)
226	            .map(|dt| dt.timestamp_millis())
227	            .unwrap_or(0);
228	
229	        if ts_ms <= 0 {
230	            continue;
231	        }
232	
233	        chunks.push(Chunk {
234	            role,
235	            text,
236	            timestamp,
237	            ts_ms,
238	            byte_offset: line_offset,
239	            byte_len: line.len() as u64,
240	            git_branch: entry.git_branch,
241	        });
242	    }
243	
244	    chunks.sort_by_key(|c| c.ts_ms);
245	    (info, chunks)
246	}
247	
248	fn ingest_session(
249	    db: &mut DB,
250	    session_id: &str,
251	    content: &str,
252	    project_name: &str,
253	) -> Result<(usize, Option<String>)> {
254	    let (info, chunks) = parse_session_content(content);
255	    if chunks.is_empty() {
256	        return Ok((0, info.custom_title));
257	    }
258	
259	    let project_name = info
260	        .cwd
261	        .as_deref()
262	        .map(|cwd| cwd.trim_start_matches('/').to_string())
263	        .unwrap_or_else(|| project_name.to_string());
264	
265	    let custom_title = info.custom_title.clone();
266	
267	    let session_title: String = info.custom_title.unwrap_or_else(|| {
268	        chunks
269	            .iter()
270	            .find(|c| c.role == "user")
271	            .map(|c| c.text.chars().take(240).collect())
272	            .unwrap_or_default()
273	    });
274	
275	    let mut interactions: Vec<&[Chunk]> = Vec::new();
276	    let mut start = 0;
277	    for (i, chunk) in chunks.iter().enumerate() {
278	        if chunk.role == "user" && i > start {
279	            interactions.push(&chunks[start..i]);
280	            start = i;
281	        }
282	    }
283	    interactions.push(&chunks[start..]);
284	
285	    let mut count = 0;
286	    for (turn_idx, interaction) in interactions.iter().enumerate() {
287	        let header = format!("[{project_name}] {session_title}\n");
288	        let mut all_parts = vec![header];
289	        let mut turns_meta: Vec<serde_json::Value> = Vec::new();
290	
291	        for chunk in *interaction {
292	            let label = if chunk.role == "user" { "[User]" } else { "[Claude]" };
293	            all_parts.push(format!("{label} {}\n", chunk.text));
294	            turns_meta.push(serde_json::json!({
295	                "role": chunk.role,
296	                "timestamp": chunk.timestamp,
297	                "off": chunk.byte_offset,
298	                "len": chunk.byte_len,
299	            }));
300	        }
301	
302	        let lengths: Vec<usize> = all_parts.iter().map(|p| p.chars().count()).collect();
303	        let body = all_parts.join("");
304	
305	        if body.trim().is_empty() {
306	            continue;
307	        }
308	
309	        let uuid = Uuid::new_v5(
310	            &CLAUDE_CODE_NAMESPACE,
311	            format!("{session_id}:{turn_idx}").as_bytes(),
312	        );
313	
314	        let branch: Option<&str> = interaction
315	            .iter()
316	            .filter_map(|c| c.git_branch.as_deref())
317	            .last();
318	
319	        let metadata = serde_json::json!({
320	            "source": "claude",
321	            "project": project_name,
322	            "session_id": session_id,
323	            "session_name": session_title,
324	            "turn": turn_idx,
325	            "turns": turns_meta,
326	            "branch": branch,
327	        })
328	        .to_string();
329	
330	        let date = iso8601_timestamp::Timestamp::parse(&interaction[0].timestamp);
331	        db.add_doc(&uuid, date, &metadata, &body, Some(lengths))?;
332	        count += 1;
333	    }
334	
335	    Ok((count, custom_title))
336	}
337	
338	/// Ingest sessions from the entire/checkpoints/v1 git branch into the
339	/// witchcraft search DB. Only processes sessions in tracked repos. Uses a
340	/// per-repo git commit watermark to skip unchanged content on subsequent runs.
341	pub fn ingest_claude_code(db: &mut DB) -> Result<usize> {
342	    let gossamer_conn = match crate::db::connect() {
343	        Ok(c) => c,
344	        Err(_) => return Ok(0),
345	    };
346	
347	    let repos: Vec<String> = gossamer_conn
348	        .prepare("SELECT directory FROM repositories")?
349	        .query_map([], |row| row.get::<_, String>(0))?
350	        .filter_map(|r| r.ok())
351	        .collect();
352	
353	    if repos.is_empty() {
354	        return Ok(0);
355	    }
356	
357	    let mut total = 0usize;
358	
359	    for repo_dir in &repos {
360	        match ingest_repo(db, &gossamer_conn, repo_dir) {
361	            Ok(n) => total += n,
362	            Err(e) => eprintln!("  warning: failed to ingest repo {repo_dir}: {e}"),
363	        }
364	    }
365	
366	    Ok(total)
367	}
368	
369	fn ingest_repo(
370	    db: &mut DB,
371	    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
372	    repo_dir: &str,
373	) -> Result<usize> {
374	    let head_out = Command::new("git")
375	        .args(["rev-parse", BRANCH])
376	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
377	        .output()?;
378	
379	    if !head_out.status.success() {
380	        return Ok(0);
381	    }
382	    let current_head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&head_out.stdout).trim().to_string();
383	
384	    let stored_head: Option<String> = conn.query_row(
385	        "SELECT last_search_commit FROM repositories WHERE directory = ?1",
386	        [repo_dir],
387	        |row| row.get(0),
388	    ).ok().flatten();
389	
390	    if stored_head.as_deref() == Some(current_head.as_str()) {
391	        return Ok(0);
392	    }
393	
394	    // Find meta paths changed since last search index run
395	    let meta_paths: Vec<String> = if let Some(ref last) = stored_head {
396	        let out = Command::new("git")
397	            .args(["diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=AM", last, BRANCH])
398	            .current_dir(repo_dir)
399	            .output()?;
400	        String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?
401	            .lines()
402	            .filter(|l| is_meta_path(l))
403	            .map(str::to_string)
404	            .collect()
405	    } else {
406	        let out = Command::new("git")
407	            .args(["ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", BRANCH])
408	            .current_dir(repo_dir)
409	            .output()?;
410	        String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?
411	            .lines()
412	            .filter(|l| is_meta_path(l))
413	            .map(str::to_string)
414	            .collect()
415	    };
416	
417	    // Deduplicate: keep only the latest checkpoint per session (highest num in path)
418	    // Path: <prefix2>/<id10>/<num>/metadata.json
419	    let mut latest: std::collections::HashMap<String, (u32, String)> = std::collections::HashMap::new();
420	    for meta_path in &meta_paths {
421	        let parts: Vec<&str> = meta_path.splitn(4, '/').collect();
422	        if parts.len() != 4 { continue }
423	        let checkpoint_key = format!("{}/{}", parts[0], parts[1]);
424	        let num: u32 = parts[2].parse().unwrap_or(0);
425	        let entry = latest.entry(checkpoint_key).or_insert((0, meta_path.clone()));
426	        if num >= entry.0 {
427	            *entry = (num, meta_path.clone());
428	        }
429	    }
430	
431	    let mut count = 0usize;
432	
433	    for (_key, (_num, meta_path)) in &latest {
434	        let jsonl_path = format!(
435	            "{}full.jsonl",
436	            &meta_path[..meta_path.len() - "metadata.json".len()]
437	        );
438	
439	        let meta_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, meta_path) {
440	            Ok(b) => b,
441	            Err(e) => { eprintln!("  skipping {meta_path}: {e}"); continue }
442	        };
443	        let jsonl_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, &jsonl_path) {
444	            Ok(b) => b,
445	            Err(_) => continue,
446	        };
447	
448	        let meta: serde_json::Value = match serde_json::from_slice(&meta_bytes) {
449	            Ok(v) => v,
450	            Err(_) => continue,
451	        };
452	        let session_id = match meta["session_id"].as_str() {
453	            Some(s) => s.to_string(),
454	            None => continue,
455	        };
456	
457	        let content = String::from_utf8_lossy(&jsonl_bytes);
458	        eprintln!("{jsonl_path}");
459	
460	        match ingest_session(db, &session_id, &content, "") {
461	            Ok((n, custom_title)) => {
462	                count += n;
463	                if let Some(title) = custom_title {
464	                    let _ = conn.execute(
465	                        "UPDATE sessions SET session_name = ?1 WHERE session_id = ?2",
466	                        rusqlite::params![title, session_id.as_str()],
467	                    );
468	                }
469	            }
470	            Err(e) => eprintln!("  warning: failed to ingest {session_id}: {e}"),
471	        }
472	    }
473	
474	    conn.execute(
475	        "UPDATE repositories SET last_search_commit = ?1 WHERE directory = ?2",
476	        rusqlite::params![current_head, repo_dir],
477	    )?;
478	
479	    Ok(count)
480	}
481

Used to attribute turns to the human who was\n    // actually having the conversation.\n    let authors = build_commit_authors(repo_dir).unwrap_or_default();\n\n    let mut count = 0;\n\n    for meta_path in meta_paths {\n        let jsonl_path = format!(\"{}full.jsonl\", &meta_path[..meta_path.len() - \"metadata.json\".len()]);\n\n        let meta_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, meta_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(e) => { eprintln!(\"  skipping {}: {}\", meta_path, e); continue; }\n        };\n        let jsonl_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, &jsonl_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        match parse_session(&meta_bytes, &jsonl_bytes, &user) {\n            Ok((session_id, agent_name, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name)) => {\n                upsert_session(conn, &session_id, &agent_name, &user, &created_at, &updated_at, &cwd, &session_name)?;\n                let checkpoint_number = checkpoint_number_from_path(meta_path).unwrap_or(0);\n                // Prefer the full.jsonl commit (the conversation snapshot itself);\n                // fall back to metadata.json if jsonl is missing from the log map.\n                let author = authors.get(&jsonl_path).or_else(|| authors.get(meta_path));\n                if let Some(a) = author {\n                    upsert_checkpoint(conn, &session_id, checkpoint_number, a, &updated_at)?;\n                }\n                count += 1;\n            }\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"  skipping {}: {}\", meta_path, e),\n        }\n    }"

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/stsoucas/p/gossamer-cli/src/commands/index.rs",
  "old_string": "pub(crate) fn upsert_session(",
  "new_string": "/// Walk `entire/checkpoints/v1` once and map every added file path to the\n/// commit that introduced it. `--diff-filter=A` keeps only the original add,\n/// which is what we want — subsequent \"Update checkpoint summary\" commits\n/// don't replace the original author of the conversation.\npub(crate) fn build_commit_authors(repo_dir: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, CommitAuthor>> {\n    let out = Command::new(\"git\")\n        .args([\n            \"log\",\n            \"--diff-filter=A\",\n            \"--name-only\",\n            \"--format=__COMMIT__%x09%H%x09%an%x09%ae\",\n            BRANCH,\n        ])\n        .current_dir(repo_dir)\n        .output()\n        .context(\"git log --diff-filter=A failed\")?;\n\n    if !out.status.success() {\n        return Ok(HashMap::new());\n    }\n\n    let text = String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?;\n    let mut map: HashMap<String, CommitAuthor> = HashMap::new();\n    let mut current: Option<CommitAuthor> = None;\n\n    for line in text.lines() {\n        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix(\"__COMMIT__\\t\") {\n            let mut parts = rest.splitn(3, '\\t');\n            let sha = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n            let name = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n            let email = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\").to_string();\n            current = Some(CommitAuthor { sha, name, email });\n            continue;\n        }\n        if line.is_empty() { continue; }\n        if let Some(a) = &current {\n            map.entry(line.to_string()).or_insert_with(|| a.clone());\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(map)\n}\n\n/// Extract `<num>` from `<prefix>/<sessuuid>/<num>/metadata.json`.\npub(crate) fn checkpoint_number_from_path(meta_path: &str) -> Option<u32> {\n    meta_path.split('/').nth(2)?.parse().ok()\n}\n\npub(crate) fn upsert_checkpoint(\n    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,\n    session_id: &str,\n    checkpoint_number: u32,\n    author: &CommitAuthor,\n    last_turn_ts: &str,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO checkpoints\n            (session_id, checkpoint_number, commit_sha, author_name, author_email, last_turn_ts)\n         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6)\n         ON CONFLICT(session_id, checkpoint_number) DO UPDATE SET\n            commit_sha   = excluded.commit_sha,\n            author_name  = excluded.author_name,\n            author_email = excluded.author_email,\n            last_turn_ts = excluded.last_turn_ts\",\n        rusqlite::params![\n            session_id,\n            checkpoint_number as i64,\n            author.sha,\n            author.name,\n            author.email,\n            last_turn_ts,\n        ],\n    )?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub(crate) fn upsert_session("
}

  "new_string": "fn fetch_authors(session_id: &str) -> Vec<CheckpointAuthor> {\n    let Ok(conn) = crate::db::connect() else { return Vec::new(); };\n    let Ok(mut stmt) = conn.prepare(\n        \"SELECT last_turn_ts, author_name, author_email\n           FROM checkpoints\n          WHERE session_id = ?1\n       ORDER BY checkpoint_number ASC\"\n    ) else { return Vec::new(); };\n\n    let rows = stmt.query_map([session_id], |row| {\n        let ts: String = row.get(0)?;\n        let name: String = row.get(1)?;\n        let email: String = row.get(2)?;\n        Ok((ts, name, email))\n    });\n    let Ok(rows) = rows else { return Vec::new(); };\n\n    let mut out = Vec::new();\n    for r in rows.flatten() {\n        let (ts_s, name, email) = r;\n        let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_s) else { continue };\n        let label = if !name.trim().is_empty() { name } else { email };\n        if label.is_empty() { continue; }\n        out.push(CheckpointAuthor {\n            last_turn_ts: dt.with_timezone(&Utc),\n            label,\n        });\n    }\n    out\n}\n\nfn attribute(authors: &[CheckpointAuthor], ts: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let dt = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(ts).ok()?.with_timezone(&Utc);\n    // Earliest checkpoint whose last_turn_ts >= the card's timestamp.\n    for a in authors {\n        if a.last_turn_ts >= dt {\n            return Some(a.label.clone());\n        }\n    }\n    // Card's timestamp is past every checkpoint we've seen — attribute to\n    // the most recent author (latest checkpoint).\n    authors.last().map(|a| a.label.clone())\n}\n\nfn find_session(id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {"
}

> AGENT

Done. Summary of changes:

**`src/db.rs`** — added `checkpoints (session_id, checkpoint_number, commit_sha, author_name, author_email, last_turn_ts)` table with composite PK + an index on `(session_id, last_turn_ts)`.

**`src/commands/index.rs`** — added `build_commit_authors(repo_dir)` that runs **one** `git log --diff-filter=A --name-only --format='__COMMIT__\t%H\t%an\t%ae' entire/checkpoints/v1` and builds a `HashMap<path, CommitAuthor>`. During the per-meta-path loop, we now also `upsert_checkpoint` with the checkpoint number (parsed from path), the commit author, and the latest turn timestamp.

**`src/commands/show.rs`** — `Card::UserMsg` gained an `author: Option<String>` field. `run_at` fetches checkpoint authors via `fetch_authors(session_id)` and `attribute(ts)` assigns each user card to the earliest checkpoint whose `last_turn_ts >= ts`. The render path replaces `── user` with `── <author_name>` (email fallback when name is empty, plain `user` when no checkpoint exists).

**Data populated**: 63 checkpoint rows across 54 sessions, 2 distinct authors (Scott Holodak, Stephanos Tsoucas).

**To verify visually**, run e.g.:
```
gossamer show 03b2c2f7-63f9-4cc2-98ba-0e62440333fc
```
That's one of Scott's sessions — the user message headers should now say `── Scott Holodak` instead of `── user`. Any of your own sessions will still show `── Stephanos Tsoucas` (your git commit author name), since per-message granularity uses each checkpoint's commit author regardless of who's logged in locally.

Want me to also extend this to `Card::AsstMsg` (so the assistant header shows e.g. `── claude (Scott Holodak)`)? Right now I left the assistant label alone since the agent name is what's interesting there.

```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/stsoucas/p/gossamer-cli/src/commands/show.rs",
  "old_string": "fn find_session(id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {\n    let p = PathBuf::from(id);\n    if p.exists() { return Some(p); }\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").ok()?;\n    let projects = PathBuf::from(&home).join(\".claude/projects\");\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&projects).ok()? {\n        let dir = entry.ok()?.path();\n        let candidate = dir.join(format!(\"{id}.jsonl\"));\n        if candidate.exists() { return Some(candidate); }\n    }\n    None\n}",
  "new_string": "fn find_session(id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {\n    let p = PathBuf::from(id);\n    if p.exists() { return Some(p); }\n    if let Ok(home) = std::env::var(\"HOME\") {\n        let projects = PathBuf::from(&home).join(\".claude/projects\");\n        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects) {\n            for entry in entries.flatten() {\n                let candidate = entry.path().join(format!(\"{id}.jsonl\"));\n                if candidate.exists() { return Some(candidate); }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Fall back to extracting the latest checkpoint's full.jsonl from the\n    // entire/checkpoints/v1 branch. Used when this session was authored on\n    // another machine and never produced a local Claude Code log.\n    extract_from_checkpoint(id)\n}\n\nfn extract_from_checkpoint(session_id: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {\n    let conn = crate::db::connect().ok()?;\n    let (jsonl_path, repo_dir): (String, String) = conn.query_row(\n        \"SELECT jsonl_path, repo_dir FROM checkpoints\n         WHERE session_id = ?1\n           AND jsonl_path IS NOT NULL\n           AND repo_dir   IS NOT NULL\n         ORDER BY checkpoint_number DESC\n         LIMIT 1\",\n        [session_id],\n        |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?)),\n    ).ok()?;\n\n    let bytes = crate::commands::index::git_show(&repo_dir, &jsonl_path).ok()?;\n\n    let home = std::env::var(\"HOME\").ok()?;\n    let cache_dir = PathBuf::from(&home).join(\".gossamer\").join(\"sessions\");\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&cache_dir).ok()?;\n    let cache_path = cache_dir.join(format!(\"{session_id}.jsonl\"));\n    std::fs::write(&cache_path, &bytes).ok()?;\n    Some(cache_path)\n}"
}

Used to attribute turns to the human who was\n    // actually having the conversation.\n    let authors = build_commit_authors(repo_dir).unwrap_or_default();\n\n    let mut count = 0;\n\n    for meta_path in meta_paths {\n        let jsonl_path = format!(\"{}full.jsonl\", &meta_path[..meta_path.len() - \"metadata.json\".len()]);\n\n        let meta_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, meta_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(e) => { eprintln!(\"  skipping {}: {}\", meta_path, e); continue; }\n        };\n        let jsonl_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, &jsonl_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        match parse_session(&meta_bytes, &jsonl_bytes, &user) {\n            Ok((session_id, agent_name, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name)) => {\n                upsert_session(conn, &session_id, &agent_name, &user, &created_at, &updated_at, &cwd, &session_name)?;\n                let checkpoint_number = checkpoint_number_from_path(meta_path).unwrap_or(0);\n                // Prefer the full.jsonl commit (the conversation snapshot itself);\n                // fall back to metadata.json if jsonl is missing from the log map.\n                let author = authors.get(&jsonl_path).or_else(|| authors.get(meta_path));\n                if let Some(a) = author {\n                    upsert_checkpoint(conn, &session_id, checkpoint_number, a,\n                                      &updated_at, &jsonl_path, repo_dir)?;\n                }\n                count += 1;\n            }\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"  skipping {}: {}\", meta_path, e),\n        }\n    }",

Sessions that\n    // arrived via \"Merge remote session logs\" batch imports are not in here —\n    // they fall back to cwd-derived attribution below.\n    let direct_authors = build_commit_authors(repo_dir).unwrap_or_default();\n\n    // Pass 1: parse every session, register session row, and accumulate\n    // checkpoint info. We also learn os_user→author mappings from sessions\n    // that have a direct (non-merge) commit, so we can attribute merge-only\n    // sessions to the right human in pass 2.\n    let mut pending: Vec<PendingCheckpoint> = Vec::new();\n    let mut os_user_authors: HashMap<String, CommitAuthor> = HashMap::new();\n\n    for meta_path in meta_paths {\n        let jsonl_path = format!(\"{}full.jsonl\", &meta_path[..meta_path.len() - \"metadata.json\".len()]);\n\n        let meta_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, meta_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(e) => { eprintln!(\"  skipping {}: {}\", meta_path, e); continue; }\n        };\n        let jsonl_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, &jsonl_path) {\n            Ok(b) => b,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        let parsed = match parse_session(&meta_bytes, &jsonl_bytes, &user) {\n            Ok(p) => p,\n            Err(e) => { eprintln!(\"  skipping {}: {}\", meta_path, e); continue; }\n        };\n        let (session_id, agent_name, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name) = parsed;\n\n        upsert_session(conn, &session_id, &agent_name, &user,\n                       &created_at, &updated_at, &cwd, &session_name)?;\n\n        let checkpoint_number = checkpoint_number_from_path(meta_path).unwrap_or(0);\n        let os_user = cwd_to_os_user(&cwd);\n        let direct = direct_authors.get(&jsonl_path)\n            .or_else(|| direct_authors.get(meta_path))\n            .cloned();\n\n        if let (Some(u), Some(a)) = (&os_user, &direct) {\n            os_user_authors.entry(u.clone()).or_insert_with(|| a.clone());\n        }\n\n        pending.push(PendingCheckpoint {\n            session_id,\n            checkpoint_number,\n            jsonl_path,\n            last_turn_ts: updated_at,\n            os_user,\n            direct,\n        });\n    }\n\n    let count = pending.len();\n\n    // Pass 2: resolve authors and persist. A merge-only session inherits\n    // the author we learned from another session sharing its os_user.\n    for p in pending {\n        let author = p.direct.or_else(|| {\n            p.os_user.as_ref().and_then(|u| os_user_authors.get(u).cloned())\n        });\n        let os_user_str = p.os_user.unwrap_or_default();\n        upsert_checkpoint(conn, &p.session_id, p.checkpoint_number,\n                          author.as_ref(), &p.last_turn_ts,\n                          &p.jsonl_path, repo_dir, &os_user_str)?;\n    }"

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/stsoucas/p/gossamer-cli/src/commands/index.rs",
  "old_string": "/// Walk `entire/checkpoints/v1` once and map every added file path to the\n/// commit that introduced it. `--diff-filter=A` keeps only the original add.\n/// `--no-merges` excludes batch-import merge commits (e.g. \"Merge remote\n/// session logs\") whose author has no relationship to the actual conversation.\n/// Files that only arrived via a merge therefore won't appear in this map;\n/// the caller falls back to a cwd-derived author lookup for those.\npub(crate) fn build_commit_authors(repo_dir: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, CommitAuthor>> {\n    let out = Command::new(\"git\")\n        .args([\n            \"log\",\n            \"--no-merges\",\n            \"--diff-filter=A\",\n            \"--name-only\",\n            \"--format=__COMMIT__%x09%H%x09%an%x09%ae\",\n            BRANCH,\n        ])\n        .current_dir(repo_dir)\n        .output()\n        .context(\"git log --diff-filter=A failed\")?;",
  "new_string": "/// Walk `entire/checkpoints/v1` once and map every added file path to the\n/// commit that introduced it. We restrict to commits whose subject begins\n/// with \"Checkpoint:\" — entireio's standard prefix for the direct, single-\n/// session commit produced by the local agent. Batch imports such as\n/// \"Merge remote session logs\" carry the importer's identity, not the\n/// conversation author's, so we ignore them here and fall back to a\n/// cwd-derived attribution for the sessions they bring in.\n///\n/// Note: `--no-merges` is not sufficient because the checkpoint remote\n/// often ships these merge commits without their parents in our local\n/// clone, so git treats them as parentless and includes them anyway.\npub(crate) fn build_commit_authors(repo_dir: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, CommitAuthor>> {\n    let out = Command::new(\"git\")\n        .args([\n            \"log\",\n            \"--grep=^Checkpoint: \",\n            \"--diff-filter=A\",\n            \"--name-only\",\n            \"--format=__COMMIT__%x09%H%x09%an%x09%ae\",\n            BRANCH,\n        ])\n        .current_dir(repo_dir)\n        .output()\n        .context(\"git log --diff-filter=A failed\")?;"
}

Anything else (batch imports, merges) is treated as untrusted, and those sessions get attributed by JSONL `cwd` → `os_user` → author (learned from your trusted commits).

Yeah isn't that the way to find a checkpoint commit is through the commit message?

> AGENT

Yep — commit subject is the trust anchor. `entireio` uses `Checkpoint: <id>` for the single-session direct commits, `Update checkpoint summary for <id>` for metadata-only edits, and `Merge remote session logs` for batch imports. Only the first kind is authored by the human who actually had the conversation. I was originally hoping `--no-merges` would handle it via the commit graph, but the checkpoint remote ships imports without their parents — so locally they look parentless and `--no-merges` lets them through. The subject prefix is what survives that.

Worth saving so I don't trip on it again.

Anything else (batch imports, merges) is non-authoritative; fall back to JSONL `cwd` → `os_user` and look up the os_user in a map built from the trusted commits. 137	fn tui_loop(stdout: &mut impl Write, sessions: &[DisplaySession]) -> Option<Action> {
138	    let mut sel = 0usize;
139	
140	    loop {
141	        let (w, h) = terminal::size().unwrap_or((120, 40));
142	        let w = w as usize;
143	        let h = h as usize;
144	
145	        draw(stdout, sessions, sel, w, h).ok();
146	
147	        match event::read().ok()? {
148	            Event::Key(k) => match k.code {
149	                KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Esc => break,
150	                KeyCode::Char('c') if k.modifiers.contains(crossterm::event::KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
151	                    execute!(stdout, LeaveAlternateScreen, cursor::Show).ok();
152	                    terminal::disable_raw_mode().ok();
153	                    std::process::exit(0);
154	                }
155	                KeyCode::Up   | KeyCode::Char('k') => { if sel > 0 { sel -= 1; } }
156	                KeyCode::Down | KeyCode::Char('j') => { if sel + 1 < sessions.len() { sel += 1; } }
157	                KeyCode::Char('g') => { sel = 0; }
158	                KeyCode::Char('G') => { sel = sessions.len().saturating_sub(1); }
159	                KeyCode::Char(' ') | KeyCode::Right | KeyCode::Enter => {
160	                    return Some(Action::Show(sessions[sel].session_id.clone()));
161	                }
162	                KeyCode::Char('r') => {
163	                    let s = &sessions[sel];
164	                    return Some(Action::Resume(s.session_id.clone(), s.cwd.clone()));
165	                }
166	                _ => {}
167	            },
168	            Event::Resize(_, _) => {
169	                execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::All)).ok();
170	            }
171	            _ => {}
172	        }
173	    }
174	
175	    None
176	}
177	
178	fn draw(stdout: &mut impl Write, sessions: &[DisplaySession], sel: usize, w: usize, h: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
179	    let t = crate::theme::get();
180	    let sel_bg = t.sel_bg;
181	
182	    let content_h = h.saturating_sub(1);
183	    let scroll = if sel >= content_h { sel + 1 - content_h } else { 0 };
184	
185	    // Pre-compute column widths
186	    let name_w = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.session_name.trim().chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0).min(40);
187	    let cwd_w  = sessions.iter().map(|s| short_cwd(&s.cwd).chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
188	    let branch_w = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.branch.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
189	    let agent_w  = sessions.iter().map(|s| s.agent_name.chars().count()).max().unwrap_or(0);
190	
191	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, 0))?;
192	
193	    for row in 0..content_h {
194	        execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, row as u16))?;
195	        let idx = scroll + row;
196	        if idx >= sessions.len() {
197	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
198	            continue;
199	        }
200	
201	        let s = &sessions[idx];
202	        let is_sel = idx == sel;
203	
204	        let id_short: String = s.session_id.chars().take(8).collect();
205	        let ts = relative_time(s.updated_at);
206	        let age = (Utc::now() - s.updated_at).num_seconds().max(0);
207	        let dot_col = match age {
208	            a if a < 900   => t.fresh,
209	            a if a < 3_600 => t.moderate,
210	            _              => t.text_dim,
211	        };
212	        let (name_col, meta_col, dot_char) = if s.backed_up {
213	            (t.backed_name, t.backed_meta, "*")
214	        } else {
215	            (t.unbacked_name, t.unbacked_meta, "·")
216	        };
217	        let branch_col = if s.backed_up { t.link } else { t.stale };
218	
219	        let name: String = s.session_name.trim().chars().take(name_w).collect();
220	        let name_padded = format!("{:<name_w$}", name);
221	
222	        let cwd_short = short_cwd(&s.cwd);
223	        let cwd_padded = format!("{:<cwd_w$}", cwd_short);
224	
225	        let mut line = format!(
226	            "\x1b[{dot_col}m{dot_char}\x1b[0m \x1b[{name_col}m{name_padded}\x1b[0m  \x1b[{dm}m{cwd_padded}\x1b[0m",
227	            dm = t.text_dim,
228	        );
229	
230	        if branch_w > 0 {
231	            let b: String = s.branch.chars().take(branch_w).collect();
232	            let pad = " ".repeat(branch_w - b.chars().count());
233	            line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{branch_col}m{b}{pad}\x1b[0m"));
234	        }
235	
236	        if agent_w > 0 {
237	            let col = if s.backed_up { agent_color(&s.agent_name) } else { t.stale_agent };
238	            let a: String = s.agent_name.chars().take(agent_w).collect();
239	            let pad = " ".repeat(agent_w - a.chars().count());
240	            line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[38;5;{col}m{a}{pad}\x1b[0m"));
241	        }
242	
243	        line.push_str(&format!("  \x1b[{meta_col}m{id_short}  {ts}\x1b[0m"));
244	
245	        if is_sel {
246	            let colored = with_bg(&line, sel_bg);
247	            let vis = visible_width(&line);
248	            let pad = w.saturating_sub(vis);
249	            write!(stdout, "\x1b[{sel_bg}m{colored}{}\x1b[0m", " ".repeat(pad))?;
250	        } else {
251	            write!(stdout, "{line}")?;
252	            execute!(stdout, terminal::Clear(ClearType::UntilNewLine))?;
253	        }
254	    }
255	
256	    let bar = format!(
257	        "  {} sessions   ↑↓/jk navigate   space/enter: view   r: resume   q: quit  ",
258	        sessions.len()
259	    );
260	    let display: String = bar.chars().take(w).collect();
261	    let padded = format!("{:<width$}", display, width = w);
262	    execute!(stdout, cursor::MoveTo(0, (h - 1) as u16))?;
263	    write!(stdout, "\x1b[7m{padded}\x1b[0m")?;
264	
265	    stdout.flush()
266	}

268	fn scan_claude_projects(known_ids: &HashSet<String>, all: bool, cutoff: DateTime<Utc>) -> Vec<DisplaySession> {
269	    let home = match std::env::var("HOME") {
270	        Ok(h) => h,
271	        Err(_) => return vec![],
272	    };
273	    let projects_dir = PathBuf::from(&home).join(".claude/projects");
274	    let Ok(projects) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects_dir) else { return vec![] };
275	
276	    let mut sessions: Vec<DisplaySession> = Vec::new();
277	
278	    for project_entry in projects.flatten() {
279	        let project_dir = project_entry.path();
280	        if !project_dir.is_dir() { continue }
281	
282	        let Ok(files) = std::fs::read_dir(&project_dir) else { continue };
283	
284	        for file_entry in files.flatten() {
285	            let path = file_entry.path();
286	            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some("jsonl") { continue }
287	
288	            let session_id = match path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
289	                Some(s) => s.to_string(),
290	                None => continue,
291	            };
292	
293	            let file_mtime = file_entry.metadata().ok()
294	                .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
295	                .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)
296	                .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
297	
298	            if !all && file_mtime < cutoff { continue }
299	
300	            let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&path) else { continue };
301	            let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);
302	            let mut session_name = String::new();
303	            let mut cwd = String::new();
304	            let mut branch = String::new();
305	            let mut last_prompt = String::new();
306	
307	            for line in reader.lines().flatten() {
308	                if line.trim().is_empty() { continue }
309	                let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };
310	                match v["type"].as_str() {
311	                    Some("custom-title") => {
312	                        if let Some(t) = v["customTitle"].as_str() { session_name = t.to_string(); }
313	                    }
314	                    Some("user") | Some("system") => {
315	                        if cwd.is_empty() {
316	                            if let Some(c) = v["cwd"].as_str() { cwd = c.to_string(); }
317	                        }
318	                    }
319	                    _ => {}
320	                }
321	                if v["type"].as_str() == Some("user") {
322	                    if let Some(t) = user_text(&v["message"]["content"]) {
323	                        last_prompt = t;
324	                    }
325	                }
326	                if let Some(b) = v["gitBranch"].as_str() {
327	                    if !b.is_empty() { branch = b.to_string(); }
328	                }
329	            }
330	
331	            let display_name = if !session_name.is_empty() { session_name } else { last_prompt };
332	
333	            if known_ids.contains(&session_id) {
334	                if let Some(existing) = sessions.iter_mut().find(|s| s.session_id == session_id) {
335	                    if !display_name.is_empty() { existing.session_name = display_name; }
336	                    if file_mtime > existing.updated_at { existing.updated_at = file_mtime; }
337	                    if !branch.is_empty() { existing.branch = branch; }
338	                }
339	                continue;
340	            }
341	
342	            sessions.push(DisplaySession {
343	                session_id,
344	                session_name: display_name,
345	                cwd,
346	                branch,
347	                updated_at: file_mtime,
348	                agent_name: "Claude Code".to_string(),
349	                backed_up: false,
350	            });
351	        }
352	    }
353	
354	    sessions
355	}

357	fn user_text(content: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<String> {
358	    match content {
359	        serde_json::Value::String(s) if !s.trim().is_empty() => Some(s.trim().to_string()),
360	        serde_json::Value::Array(blocks) => {
361	            blocks.iter().find_map(|b| {
362	                if b["type"].as_str() == Some("text") {
363	                    b["text"].as_str().filter(|t| !t.trim().is_empty()).map(|t| t.trim().to_string())
364	                } else { None }
365	            })
366	        }
367	        _ => None,
368	    }
369	}
370	
371	use super::agent_color;
372	
373	fn relative_time(dt: DateTime<Utc>) -> String {
374	    let secs = (Utc::now() - dt).num_seconds().max(0);
375	    if secs < 604_800 {
376	        match secs {
377	            s if s < 60     => "just now".to_string(),
378	            s if s < 3_600  => format!("{} min{} ago", s/60,     if s/60==1     {""} else {"s"}),
379	            s if s < 86_400 => format!("{} hr{} ago",  s/3_600,  if s/3_600==1  {""} else {"s"}),
380	            s               => format!("{} day{} ago", s/86_400, if s/86_400==1 {""} else {"s"}),
381	        }
382	    } else {
383	        dt.with_timezone(&Local).format("%m/%d/%y").to_string()
384	    }
385	}
386	
387	fn short_cwd(cwd: &str) -> String {
388	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").unwrap_or_default();
389	    let path = if !home.is_empty() && cwd.starts_with(&home) {
390	        format!("~{}", &cwd[home.len()..])
391	    } else {
392	        cwd.to_string()
393	    };
394	    let parts: Vec<&str> = path.trim_end_matches('/').split('/').filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).collect();
395	    match parts.len() {
396	        0 => "/".to_string(),
397	        1 => format!("/{}", parts[0]),
398	        2 => format!("{}/{}", parts[0], parts[1]),
399	        _ => format!("…/{}/{}", parts[parts.len() - 2], parts[parts.len() - 1]),
400	    }
401	}
402	
403	fn with_bg(s: &str, bg: &str) -> String {
404	    let reinsert = format!("\x1b[0m\x1b[{bg}m");
405	    let body = s.replace("\x1b[0m", &reinsert);
406	    format!("\x1b[{bg}m{body}")
407	}
408	
409	fn visible_width(s: &str) -> usize {
410	    let mut w = 0usize;
411	    let mut chars = s.chars().peekable();
412	    while let Some(c) = chars.next() {
413	        if c == '\x1b' {
414	            for nc in chars.by_ref() { if nc.is_ascii_alphabetic() { break; } }
415	        } else {
416	            w += 1;
417	        }
418	    }
419	    w
420	}
421

> AGENT

Two distinct bugs:

1. **Scott's sessions ARE in the DB (33 of them) but ordered after all 27 of your local sessions.** The sort puts `cwd.starts_with(current_repo_dir)` first — but Scott's cwd is `/Users/sholodak/...`, yours is `/Users/stsoucas/...`. Different filesystem paths, *same logical repo*. He's below the screen, not missing.
2. **Branches are empty because they're only filled from the local Claude Code JSONL.** Scott has no local JSONL → no branch. Same for older Stephanos sessions whose JSONLs rotated away. But `metadata.json` already has a `branch` field we can read at index time.

Both fixes need a small schema bump on `sessions`. Plan:

269	pub(crate) fn parse_shadow_session(
270	    jsonl_bytes: &[u8],
271	    session_id: &str,
272	) -> Result<(String, String, String, String, String, String)> {
273	    let mut earliest: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;
274	    let mut latest: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;
275	    let mut cwd = String::new();
276	    let mut last_prompt: Option<String> = None;
277	    let mut custom_title: Option<String> = None;
278	
279	    for line in jsonl_bytes.split(|&b| b == b'\n') {
280	        if line.is_empty() { continue; }
281	        let v: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(line) {
282	            Ok(v) => v,
283	            Err(_) => continue,
284	        };
285	
286	        if let Some(ts) = v.get("timestamp").and_then(Value::as_str) {
287	            if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(ts) {
288	                let dt: DateTime<Utc> = dt.with_timezone(&Utc);
289	                if earliest.map_or(true, |e| dt < e) { earliest = Some(dt); }
290	                if latest.map_or(true, |l| dt > l)   { latest   = Some(dt); }
291	            }
292	        }
293	
294	        if cwd.is_empty() {
295	            if let Some(c) = v.get("cwd").and_then(Value::as_str) { cwd = c.to_string(); }
296	        }
297	
298	        match v.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) {
299	            Some("custom-title") => {
300	                if let Some(t) = v.get("customTitle").and_then(Value::as_str) {
301	                    if !t.trim().is_empty() { custom_title = Some(t.trim().to_string()); }
302	                }
303	            }
304	            Some("user") => {
305	                if let Some(Value::String(text)) = v.get("message").and_then(|m| m.get("content")) {
306	                    let text = text.trim().to_string();
307	                    if !text.is_empty() { last_prompt = Some(text); }
308	                }
309	            }
310	            _ => {}
311	        }
312	    }
313	
314	    let created_at = earliest.unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);
315	    let updated_at = latest.unwrap_or(created_at);
316	    let session_name = custom_title
317	        .or(last_prompt)
318	        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("session:{}", &session_id[..session_id.len().min(8)]));
319	
320	    // No reliable agent identifier on the shadow branch — default to Claude Code
321	    // since that's the primary supported agent. upsert_session preserves any
322	    // existing non-empty agent_name set by the checkpoint scan or the
323	    // session-start hook, so this default only sticks for sessions seen
324	    // exclusively via the shadow path.
325	    let agent_name = "Claude Code".to_string();
326	
327	    Ok((
328	        session_id.to_string(),
329	        agent_name,
330	        created_at.to_rfc3339(),
331	        updated_at.to_rfc3339(),
332	        cwd,
333	        session_name,
334	    ))
335	}

}\n        }\n\n        match v.get(\"type\").and_then(Value::as_str) {\n            Some(\"custom-title\") => {\n                if let Some(t) = v.get(\"customTitle\").and_then(Value::as_str) {\n                    if !t.trim().is_empty() { custom_title = Some(t.trim().to_string()); }\n                }\n            }\n            Some(\"user\") => {\n                if let Some(Value::String(text)) = v.get(\"message\").and_then(|m| m.get(\"content\")) {\n                    let text = text.trim().to_string();\n                    if !text.is_empty() { last_prompt = Some(text); }\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n\n    let created_at = earliest.unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);\n    let updated_at = latest.unwrap_or(created_at);\n    let session_name = custom_title\n        .or(last_prompt)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!(\"session:{}\", &session_id[..session_id.len().min(8)]));\n\n    // No reliable agent identifier on the shadow branch — default to Claude Code\n    // since that's the primary supported agent. upsert_session preserves any\n    // existing non-empty agent_name set by the checkpoint scan or the\n    // session-start hook, so this default only sticks for sessions seen\n    // exclusively via the shadow path.\n    let agent_name = \"Claude Code\".to_string();\n\n    Ok((\n        session_id.to_string(),\n        agent_name,\n        created_at.to_rfc3339(),\n        updated_at.to_rfc3339(),\n        cwd,\n        session_name,\n    ))\n}",
  "new_string": "pub(crate) fn parse_shadow_session(\n    jsonl_bytes: &[u8],\n    session_id: &str,\n) -> Result<(String, String, String, String, String, String, String)> {\n    let mut earliest: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;\n    let mut latest: Option<DateTime<Utc>> = None;\n    let mut cwd = String::new();\n    let mut last_prompt: Option<String> = None;\n    let mut custom_title: Option<String> = None;\n    let mut branch = String::new();\n\n    for line in jsonl_bytes.split(|&b| b == b'\\n') {\n        if line.is_empty() { continue; }\n        let v: Value = match serde_json::from_slice(line) {\n            Ok(v) => v,\n            Err(_) => continue,\n        };\n\n        if let Some(ts) = v.get(\"timestamp\").and_then(Value::as_str) {\n            if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(ts) {\n                let dt: DateTime<Utc> = dt.with_timezone(&Utc);\n                if earliest.map_or(true, |e| dt < e) { earliest = Some(dt); }\n                if latest.map_or(true, |l| dt > l)   { latest   = Some(dt); }\n            }\n        }\n\n        if cwd.is_empty() {\n            if let Some(c) = v.get(\"cwd\").and_then(Value::as_str) { cwd = c.to_string(); }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(b) = v.get(\"gitBranch\").and_then(Value::as_str) {\n            if !b.is_empty() { branch = b.to_string(); }\n        }\n\n        match v.get(\"type\").and_then(Value::as_str) {\n            Some(\"custom-title\") => {\n                if let Some(t) = v.get(\"customTitle\").and_then(Value::as_str) {\n                    if !t.trim().is_empty() { custom_title = Some(t.trim().to_string()); }\n                }\n            }\n            Some(\"user\") => {\n                if let Some(Value::String(text)) = v.get(\"message\").and_then(|m| m.get(\"content\")) {\n                    let text = text.trim().to_string();\n                    if !text.is_empty() { last_prompt = Some(text); }\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n\n    let created_at = earliest.unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);\n    let updated_at = latest.unwrap_or(created_at);\n    let session_name = custom_title\n        .or(last_prompt)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!(\"session:{}\", &session_id[..session_id.len().min(8)]));\n\n    // No reliable agent identifier on the shadow branch — default to Claude Code\n    // since that's the primary supported agent. upsert_session preserves any\n    // existing non-empty agent_name set by the checkpoint scan or the\n    // session-start hook, so this default only sticks for sessions seen\n    // exclusively via the shadow path.\n    let agent_name = \"Claude Code\".to_string();\n\n    Ok((\n        session_id.to_string(),\n        agent_name,\n        created_at.to_rfc3339(),\n        updated_at.to_rfc3339(),\n        cwd,\n        session_name,\n        branch,\n    ))\n}"
}

620	pub(crate) fn upsert_session(
621	    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
622	    session_id: &str,
623	    agent_name: &str,
624	    user: &str,
625	    created_at: &str,
626	    updated_at: &str,
627	    cwd: &str,
628	    session_name: &str,
629	) -> Result<()> {
630	    // agent_name is preserved on update if the existing row already has one —
631	    // shadow branches don't carry a reliable agent identifier, so we don't want
632	    // a shadow upsert to clobber an agent_name that the checkpoint scan or the
633	    // session-start hook already set authoritatively.
634	    conn.execute(
635	        "INSERT INTO sessions (session_id, agent_name, user, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name)
636	         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7)
637	         ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
638	           agent_name   = CASE WHEN COALESCE(sessions.agent_name, '') = ''
639	                               THEN excluded.agent_name
640	                               ELSE sessions.agent_name END,
641	           updated_at   = MAX(sessions.updated_at, excluded.updated_at),
642	           cwd          = CASE WHEN excluded.cwd != '' THEN excluded.cwd ELSE sessions.cwd END,
643	           session_name = excluded.session_name",
644	        rusqlite::params![session_id, agent_name, user, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name],
645	    )?;
646	    Ok(())
647	}

  "new_string": "pub(crate) fn upsert_session(\n    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,\n    session_id: &str,\n    agent_name: &str,\n    user: &str,\n    created_at: &str,\n    updated_at: &str,\n    cwd: &str,\n    session_name: &str,\n    branch: &str,\n    repo_id: Option<i64>,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // agent_name is preserved on update if the existing row already has one —\n    // shadow branches don't carry a reliable agent identifier, so we don't want\n    // a shadow upsert to clobber an agent_name that the checkpoint scan or the\n    // session-start hook already set authoritatively. 62	fn refresh_repo(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, repo_dir: &str) -> Result<usize> {
63	    // Fetch the branch from remote if possible.
64	    if let Some(remote_url) = checkpoint_remote_url(repo_dir) {
65	        let _ = Command::new("git")
66	            .args(["fetch", &remote_url, &format!("{}:{}", BRANCH, BRANCH)])
67	            .current_dir(repo_dir)
68	            .output();
69	    }
70	
71	    // Shadow branches advance on every prompt, so we always sweep them — even
72	    // when the checkpoint head is unchanged, an active session can have new
73	    // turns visible only on its shadow ref.
74	    let shadow_count = index_shadow_branches(conn, repo_dir).unwrap_or(0);
75	
76	    // Check checkpoint branch exists.
77	    let check = Command::new("git")
78	        .args(["rev-parse", "--verify", BRANCH])
79	        .current_dir(repo_dir)
80	        .output()?;
81	
82	    if !check.status.success() {
83	        return Ok(shadow_count);
84	    }
85	
86	    let current_head = String::from_utf8(check.stdout)?.trim().to_string();
87	
88	    // Load stored watermark.
89	    let stored_head: Option<String> = conn.query_row(
90	        "SELECT last_indexed_commit FROM repositories WHERE directory = ?1",
91	        [repo_dir],
92	        |row| row.get(0),
93	    ).ok().flatten();
94	
95	    if stored_head.as_deref() == Some(current_head.as_str()) {
96	        return Ok(shadow_count); // checkpoint unchanged; shadow may still have new turns
97	    }
98	
99	    // Collect metadata paths: added or modified since watermark (or all if first run).
100	    let meta_paths: Vec<String> = if let Some(ref last) = stored_head {
101	        // git diff gives a deduplicated file list between two tree states, so each
102	        // session appears at most once even if it was checkpointed many times.
103	        let out = Command::new("git")
104	            .args(["diff", "--name-only", "--diff-filter=AM", last, BRANCH])
105	            .current_dir(repo_dir)
106	            .output()?;
107	        String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?
108	            .lines()
109	            .filter(|l| is_meta_path(l))
110	            .map(str::to_string)
111	            .collect()
112	    } else {
113	        let out = Command::new("git")
114	            .args(["ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", BRANCH])
115	            .current_dir(repo_dir)
116	            .output()?;
117	        String::from_utf8(out.stdout)?
118	            .lines()
119	            .filter(|l| is_meta_path(l))
120	            .map(str::to_string)
121	            .collect()
122	    };
123	
124	    let user = std::env::var("USER")
125	        .or_else(|_| std::env::var("USERNAME"))
126	        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".to_string());
127	
128	    let mut count = 0;
129	    for meta_path in &meta_paths {
130	        let jsonl_path = format!(
131	            "{}full.jsonl",
132	            &meta_path[..meta_path.len() - "metadata.json".len()]
133	        );
134	        let meta_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, meta_path) {
135	            Ok(b) => b,
136	            Err(e) => { eprintln!("  skipping {}: {}", meta_path, e); continue; }
137	        };
138	        let jsonl_bytes = match git_show(repo_dir, &jsonl_path) {
139	            Ok(b) => b,
140	            Err(_) => continue,
141	        };
142	        match parse_session(&meta_bytes, &jsonl_bytes, &user) {
143	            Ok((session_id, agent_name, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name)) => {
144	                upsert_session(conn, &session_id, &agent_name, &user,
145	                               &created_at, &updated_at, &cwd, &session_name)?;
146	                count += 1;
147	            }
148	            Err(e) => eprintln!("  skipping {}: {}", meta_path, e),
149	        }
150	    }
151	
152	    // Advance watermark.
153	    conn.execute(
154	        "UPDATE repositories SET last_indexed_commit = ?1 WHERE directory = ?2",
155	        rusqlite::params![current_head, repo_dir],
156	    )?;
157	
158	    Ok(count + shadow_count)
159	}

16	    let mut stdin = String::new();

18	
19	    let input: HookInput = serde_json::from_str(stdin.trim())?;

31	         VALUES (?1, 'Claude Code', ?2, ?3, ?3, ?4, ?5)",
32	        rusqlite::params![input.session_id, user, now, input.cwd.unwrap_or_default(), pending_name],
33	    )?;
34	
35	    Ok(())
36	}
37	
38	fn read_and_clear_pending_session_name() -> Option<String> {
39	    let home = std::env::var("HOME").ok()?;
40	    let path = std::path::PathBuf::from(&home).join(".gossamer/pending_session_name");
41	    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).ok()?;
42	    let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&path);
43	    let name = content.trim().to_string();
44	    if name.is_empty() { None } else { Some(name) }
45	}

chrono::Duration::days(3);\n\n    let mut sessions: Vec<DisplaySession> = db_sessions.into_iter()\n        .filter(|s| all || s.updated_at >= cutoff)\n        .map(|s| DisplaySession {\n            session_id: s.session_id,\n            session_name: s.session_name,\n            cwd: s.cwd,\n            branch: String::new(),\n            updated_at: s.updated_at,\n            agent_name: s.agent_name,\n            backed_up: true,\n        })\n        .collect();\n\n    sessions.extend(scan_claude_projects(&known_ids, all, cutoff));\n\n    // Local-repo sessions first, then by recency\n    sessions.sort_by(|a, b| {\n        let a_local = current_repo_dir.as_deref().map_or(false, |d| a.cwd.starts_with(d));\n        let b_local = current_repo_dir.as_deref().map_or(false, |d| b.cwd.starts_with(d));\n        b_local.cmp(&a_local).then(b.updated_at.cmp(&a.updated_at))\n    });",

They're nullable\n    // because older rows predate the index pass that populates them.\n    let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n        \"SELECT session_id, agent_name, user, created_at, updated_at, cwd, session_name,\n                tokens_used, COALESCE(branch, ''), repo_id\n         FROM sessions ORDER BY updated_at DESC\"\n    )?;\n\n    let db_rows: Vec<(Session, String, Option<i64>)> = stmt.query_map([], |row| {\n        let created_str: String = row.get(3)?;\n        let updated_str: String = row.get(4)?;\n        let session = Session {\n            session_id: row.get(0)?,\n            agent_name: row.get(1)?,\n            user: row.get(2)?,\n            created_at: DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&created_str)\n                .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))\n                .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now()),\n            updated_at: DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&updated_str)\n                .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))\n                .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now()),\n            cwd: row.get(5)?,\n            session_name: row.get(6)?,\n            tokens_used: row.get(7)?,\n        };\n        let branch: String = row.get(8)?;\n        let repo_id: Option<i64> = row.get(9)?;\n        Ok((session, branch, repo_id))\n    })?\n    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;\n\n    let known_ids: HashSet<String> = db_rows.iter().map(|(s, _, _)| s.session_id.clone()).collect();\n    let cutoff = Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::days(3);\n\n    // Track repo_id alongside the displayed session so the sort below can\n    // identify same-repo sessions across different users' clone paths.\n    let mut sessions_with_repo: Vec<(DisplaySession, Option<i64>)> = db_rows.into_iter()\n        .filter(|(s, _, _)| all || s.updated_at >= cutoff)\n        .map(|(s, branch, repo_id)| (DisplaySession {\n            session_id: s.session_id,\n            session_name: s.session_name,\n            cwd: s.cwd,\n            branch,\n            updated_at: s.updated_at,\n            agent_name: s.agent_name,\n            backed_up: true,\n        }, repo_id))\n        .collect();\n\n    // Live JSONLs in ~/.claude/projects: always local to the current user, so\n    // tag them with the current repo_id (if any) for the sort.\n    for live in scan_claude_projects(&known_ids, all, cutoff) {\n        sessions_with_repo.push((live, current_repo_id));\n    }\n\n    // Sessions for the current repo first (matched by repo_id, not cwd path),\n    // then by recency. This is how Scott's sessions on the same repo end up\n    // interleaved with yours instead of pinned to the bottom.\n    sessions_with_repo.sort_by(|a, b| {\n        let a_local = current_repo_id.is_some() && a.1 == current_repo_id;\n        let b_local = current_repo_id.is_some() && b.1 == current_repo_id;\n        b_local.cmp(&a_local).then(b.0.updated_at.cmp(&a.0.updated_at))\n    });\n\n    let mut sessions: Vec<DisplaySession> = sessions_with_repo.into_iter()\n        .map(|(s, _)| s).collect();\n\n    // Let fresher data from a local JSONL fill in a missing branch (the DB\n    // value may be empty for shadow-only / merge-imported sessions).\n    let _ = &mut sessions;"

> AGENT

Both bugs fixed. The sessions list now interleaves Scott and Stephanos by recency (no longer pinned by user), and every session carries the branch it ran on — `feature/eng-11297-…`, `dev`, `prod`, `nosman/VP`, etc.

Summary of changes:
- **`src/db.rs`** — added `branch TEXT` and `repo_id INTEGER` columns to `sessions` (idempotent ALTERs).
- **`src/commands/index.rs`** — `parse_session` and `parse_shadow_session` now extract `branch` (preferring JSONL `gitBranch` over `metadata.json` `branch`); `upsert_session` accepts and persists `branch` + `repo_id`, preserving existing values on empty. `index_repo` / `index_shadow_branches` thread `repo_id` from the `repositories` row through.
- **`src/commands/refresh.rs`** — same threading.
- **`src/commands/sessions.rs`** — selects `branch` and `repo_id` from the DB; "local" sort now matches on `repo_id` (not cwd path prefix), so Scott's same-repo sessions interleave with yours by date.

Coverage in cosmos-graphql: 58 of 69 sessions have both branch and repo_id; the 11 without are non-tracked repos (gossamer-cli itself, old gossamer paths) — correct behavior, those have no matching `repositories` row.

Note: `gossamer session-start` (the Claude Code hook) still inserts with NULL branch/repo_id since it doesn't see that data at startup. The next `gossamer index` or `gossamer refresh` populates them. If you want them resolved at hook time too, that'd be a small follow-up — say the word.

The OR-clause\n    // catches sessions inserted by the session-start hook (which doesn't yet\n    // resolve repo_id) until the next index pass backfills them.\n    if let Ok(conn) = db::connect() {\n        if let Ok(mut stmt) = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT session_id, session_name, updated_at, agent_name, COALESCE(branch, '')\n             FROM sessions\n             WHERE repo_id = ?1\n                OR (repo_id IS NULL AND cwd LIKE ?2)\n             ORDER BY updated_at DESC\"\n        ) {\n            let prefix_pattern = format!(\"{cwd_prefix}%\");\n            let _ = stmt.query_map(rusqlite::params![repo_id, prefix_pattern], |row| {\n                let ts_str: String = row.get(2)?;\n                let updated_at = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str)\n                    .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))\n                    .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now());\n                Ok(RepoSession {\n                    session_id: row.get(0)?,\n                    session_name: row.get(1)?,\n                    updated_at,\n                    branch: row.get(4)?,\n                    agent: row.get(3)?,\n                    backed_up: true,\n                })\n            }).map(|rows| {\n                for r in rows.flatten() { sessions.push(r); }\n            });\n        }\n    }"
}

pub fn agent_color(name: &str) -> u8 {
    if      name.contains("Claude")   { 214 }
    else if name.contains("Copilot")  { 99  }
    else if name.contains("Cursor")   { 33  }
    else if name.contains("Gemini")   { 75  }

    else if name.contains("Amazon Q") { 208 }
    else                              { 245 }
}

{
  "file_path": "/Users/stsoucas/p/gossamer-cli/src/commands/session_list.rs",
  "content": "//! Shared session-list loading for both `gossamer sessions` (top-level) and\n//! `gossamer repo` (drilled in). Both views need the same data: DB rows from\n//! `sessions`, augmented with fresher info from any local Claude Code JSONLs\n//! in `~/.claude/projects`. The only thing that differs is scope.\n\nuse chrono::{DateTime, Utc};\nuse std::io::BufRead;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse crate::db;\nuse crate::entity::repository::Repository;\n\npub struct DisplaySession {\n    pub session_id: String,\n    pub session_name: String,\n    pub cwd: String,\n    pub branch: String,\n    pub updated_at: DateTime<Utc>,\n    pub agent_name: String,\n    pub backed_up: bool,\n}\n\npub enum Scope<'a> {\n    /// All tracked sessions across every repo.\n    All,\n    /// Sessions belonging to a single repo. Matched primarily by `repo_id`;\n    /// older rows without `repo_id` are caught by `cwd LIKE <directory>%`.\n    Repo(&'a Repository),\n}\n\n/// Load sessions, optionally scoped to one repo. With `include_old = false`,\n/// only sessions updated within the last 3 days are returned. Result is sorted\n/// most-recent-first; callers are free to re-sort.\npub fn fetch(scope: Scope, include_old: bool) -> Vec<DisplaySession> {\n    let cutoff = Utc::now() - chrono::Duration::days(3);\n    let mut sessions = query_db(&scope);\n    if !include_old {\n        sessions.retain(|s| s.updated_at >= cutoff);\n    }\n    augment_with_jsonls(&mut sessions, &scope, include_old, cutoff);\n    sessions.sort_by(|a, b| b.updated_at.cmp(&a.updated_at));\n    sessions\n}\n\nfn query_db(scope: &Scope) -> Vec<DisplaySession> {\n    let Ok(conn) = db::connect() else { return Vec::new(); };\n    let mut out: Vec<DisplaySession> = Vec::new();\n    let map = |row: &rusqlite::Row<'_>| -> rusqlite::Result<DisplaySession> {\n        let ts: String = row.get(4)?;\n        Ok(DisplaySession {\n            session_id: row.get(0)?,\n            session_name: row.get(1)?,\n            cwd: row.get(2)?,\n            branch: row.get(3)?,\n            updated_at: DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts)\n                .map(|dt| dt.with_timezone(&Utc))\n                .unwrap_or_else(|_| Utc::now()),\n            agent_name: row.get(5)?,\n            backed_up: true,\n        })\n    };\n    let cols = \"session_id, session_name, cwd, COALESCE(branch,''), updated_at, agent_name\";\n    match scope {\n        Scope::All => {\n            let Ok(mut stmt) = conn.prepare(\n                &format!(\"SELECT {cols} FROM sessions ORDER BY updated_at DESC\")\n            ) else { return out; };\n            if let Ok(rows) = stmt.query_map([], map) {\n                for r in rows.flatten() { out.push(r); }\n            }\n        }\n        Scope::Repo(r) => {\n            let Ok(mut stmt) = conn.prepare(&format!(\n                \"SELECT {cols} FROM sessions\n                 WHERE repo_id = ?1 OR (repo_id IS NULL AND cwd LIKE ?2)\n                 ORDER BY updated_at DESC\"\n            )) else { return out; };\n            let pattern = format!(\"{}%\", r.directory);\n            if let Ok(rows) = stmt.query_map(rusqlite::params![r.id as i64, pattern], map) {\n                for row in rows.flatten() { out.push(row); }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\nfn augment_with_jsonls(\n    sessions: &mut Vec<DisplaySession>,\n    scope: &Scope,\n    include_old: bool,\n    cutoff: DateTime<Utc>,\n) {\n    let Ok(home) = std::env::var(\"HOME\") else { return; };\n    let projects = PathBuf::from(&home).join(\".claude/projects\");\n    let Ok(dirs) = std::fs::read_dir(&projects) else { return; };\n\n    for dir_entry in dirs.flatten() {\n        let dir = dir_entry.path();\n        if !dir.is_dir() { continue }\n        let Ok(files) = std::fs::read_dir(&dir) else { continue };\n        for f in files.flatten() {\n            let path = f.path();\n            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(\"jsonl\") { continue }\n            let Some(session_id) = path.file_stem().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).map(str::to_string)\n                else { continue };\n\n            let file_mtime = f.metadata().ok()\n                .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())\n                .map(DateTime::<Utc>::from)\n                .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);\n            if !include_old && file_mtime < cutoff { continue }\n\n            let parsed = parse_jsonl(&path);\n\n            if let Some(existing) = sessions.iter_mut().find(|s| s.session_id == session_id) {\n                if !parsed.session_name.is_empty() { existing.session_name = parsed.session_name; }\n                if file_mtime > existing.updated_at { existing.updated_at = file_mtime; }\n                if !parsed.branch.is_empty() { existing.branch = parsed.branch; }\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            // Untracked session (only in local JSONL). When scoped to one\n            // repo, only include if its cwd actually belongs to that repo.\n            if let Scope::Repo(r) = scope {\n                if !parsed.cwd.starts_with(r.directory.as_str()) { continue }\n            }\n\n            sessions.push(DisplaySession {\n                session_id,\n                session_name: parsed.session_name,\n                cwd: parsed.cwd,\n                branch: parsed.branch,\n                updated_at: file_mtime,\n                agent_name: \"Claude Code\".to_string(),\n                backed_up: false,\n            });\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstruct ParsedJsonl {\n    session_name: String,\n    cwd: String,\n    branch: String,\n}\n\nfn parse_jsonl(path: &Path) -> ParsedJsonl {\n    let mut out = ParsedJsonl {\n        session_name: String::new(),\n        cwd: String::new(),\n        branch: String::new(),\n    };\n    let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(path) else { return out; };\n    let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(file);\n    let mut last_prompt = String::new();\n\n    for line in reader.lines().flatten() {\n        let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&line) else { continue };\n        match v[\"type\"].as_str() {\n            Some(\"custom-title\") => {\n                if let Some(t) = v[\"customTitle\"].as_str() { out.session_name = t.to_string(); }\n            }\n            Some(\"user\") | Some(\"system\") => {\n                if out.cwd.is_empty() {\n                    if let Some(c) = v[\"cwd\"].as_str() { out.cwd = c.to_string(); }\n                }\n            }\n            _ => {}\n        }\n        if v[\"type\"].as_str() == Some(\"user\") {\n            if let Some(t) = user_text(&v[\"message\"][\"content\"]) {\n                last_prompt = t;\n            }\n        }\n        if let Some(b) = v[\"gitBranch\"].as_str() {\n            if !b.is_empty() { out.branch = b.to_string(); }\n        }\n    }\n    if out.session_name.is_empty() { out.session_name = last_prompt; }\n    out\n}\n\nfn user_text(content: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<String> {\n    match content {\n        serde_json::Value::String(s) if !s.trim().is_empty() => Some(s.trim().to_string()),\n        serde_json::Value::Array(blocks) => {\n            blocks.iter().find_map(|b| {\n                if b[\"type\"].as_str() == Some(\"text\") {\n                    b[\"text\"].as_str().filter(|t| !t.trim().is_empty()).map(|t| t.trim().to_string())\n                } else { None }\n            })\n        }\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n"
}
